name: sci-paper
description: Scientific paper writing + review + ideation pipeline for top-tier journals (ApJ/MNRAS/PRD/JCAP-class). Ships 9 skills and 21 tools under one typed scientific-writing standard: source-traced integrity blockers, zero-target L0, ranked advisories, explicit measurement states, claim-faithful rewriting, and isolated multi-review orchestration. See CHANGELOG.md for per-version history.
